chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about fasting the days of Tashriq, so he said, 'As for the provinces (outside Mina), there is no harm, but as for Mina, there is (harm/it is not permissible).'

And as for the fasting of continuous fasting (Sawm al-Visal), it is when one makes his evening meal his morning meal (eating dinner and skipping the pre-dawn meal, continuing until the next dinner), so that is prohibited. He narrated that.

key_terms.صَوْمُ الْوِصَالِ: Continuous fasting (fasting from dawn to night without eating at night)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting during the days of Tashriq in Mina versus other places?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the juristic distinction between fasting in Mina versus other regions during the Days of Tashriq, reflecting the specific context of the Hajj rituals. It further defines *Sawm al-Visal* as continuous fasting without an evening meal, declaring it prohibited to prevent hardship, a ruling consistent with the Prophetic tradition of avoiding extreme asceticism in worship.
